toml:
# Coupled joint sensor-fusion PNT: the same suites and GNSS outage as `fusion-pnt.toml`, but
# the navigator is ONE stacked Kalman filter over position, velocity, clock phase, clock
# frequency and the accelerometer bias (the `[coupled]` table). While GNSS is nominal it takes
# pseudoranges, each `rho = g * position + c * clock phase + noise` along a line-of-sight factor
# g, so a single measurement constrains position and clock together and the filter carries
# their cross-covariance; the optical time-transfer re-syncs during the outage are clock-only
# pseudoranges. The accelerometers here carry a constant bias, which the bias state learns
# before the outage (`fusion-pnt.toml` zeroes the biases because its filters have no bias
# state). Vendor-neutral; clock and noise parameters as in `fusion-pnt.toml`, the biases are
# illustrative. MODELLED.
kind = "fusion"
seed = 42
timing_spec_ns = 20.0
position_spec_m = 100.0

[time]
step_s = 10.0
duration_s = 7200.0

[gnss]
windows = [
  { t0 = 0.0,   t1 = 600.0,  state = "nominal" },
  { t0 = 600.0, t1 = 7200.0, state = "denied" },
]

[resync]
enabled = true
interval_s = 1800.0
sigma_j_s = 1.0e-12

[clock_quantum]
id = "optical-sr-lattice"
provenance = "Strontium optical lattice clock, space-oriented goal sigma_y(1s)=1e-15 (arXiv:1503.08457)"
y0 = 5.0e-17
q_wf = 1.0e-30
q_rw = 0.0
drift = 0.0

[clock_classical]
id = "csac-sa45s"
provenance = "Microchip SA65 / SA.45s CSAC datasheet sigma_y(1s)=3e-10"
y0 = 5.0e-10
q_wf = 9.0e-20
q_rw = 0.0
drift = 0.0

[accel_quantum]
id = "cold-atom-quat"
provenance = "Cold-atom accelerometer, low long-tau velocity-random-walk; illustrative noise-driven value with an illustrative constant bias"
bias = 2.0e-5
q_va = 1.0e-9

[accel_classical]
id = "nav-grade-quartz"
provenance = "Navigation-grade quartz accelerometer; illustrative noise-driven value with an illustrative constant bias"
bias = 2.0e-4
q_va = 1.0e-7

[coupled]
sigma_pr_m = 1.0
geometry = [1.0, -0.7, 0.4, -0.2]
q_ba = 0.0
bias_var = 1.0e-6
summary: scenario 45a56232fc75 | fused | quantum PNT-holdover 6600s (t 6600s/p 6600s) integrity 1.000 security n/a (no attack) | classical PNT-holdover 1330s (t 1330s/p 6510s) integrity 0.973 security n/a (no attack)
